name: Helloprint

sizeBand.basis: Vacancy says "work with 100+ professionals from 25+ nationalities in Rotterdam and Valencia"

signal: Helloprint posted an Office & Culture Manager vacancy for its Rotterdam office whose job includes running company events from concept to clean-up.
sourceQuote: You organise our HelloPrint events, meetings and special moments. From concept to clean-up. Budget, venue, planning and execution on the day.
why: The new hire will own events like their Season Kick-Off and needs reliable suppliers fast, and a branded strip at €299 is an easy first booking for someone building their supplier list.
contactRole: office & culture manager (new hire) or VP of People
notes: Signal date is the Recruitee publish date (API published_at 2026-10-22, page datePosted 2026-10-22). The vacancy also names a 'Season Prep Night' and 'Season Kick-Off' as events outside office hours.

name: Payter
signal: Payter calls itself a fast-growing scale-up of about 100 people and has 10 Rotterdam vacancies with publish dates between 14 Jul and 3 Nov 2026 on its Recruitee feed.
sourceQuote: Als snelgroeiende scale-up met circa 100 gedreven professionals combineren we innovatie en ondernemerschap met de ontwikkeling van onze eigen hardware en software.
why: A company adding around ten people at once tends to mark the year end with everyone together, and a €299 booth with the Payter logo on every strip suits a first big team party.
notes: Vacancy count from https://payter.recruitee.com/api/offers read 2026-11-03: Rotterdam roles with published_at from 2026-07-14 to 2026-11-03 = 10. published_at can be a republish date. An 'Office, Facility & Event Manager' role was named in a search snippet but is NOT in the live feed, so it is not used.

name: Quintor
signal: Quintor is hiring an office manager for its Den Haag office whose tasks include organising events and gatherings.
why: The office manager who organises their events is exactly who books a photobooth, and one booking per office (five locations) can repeat.
notes: WEAKEST DATE in the list. Posted 2026-06-26 (datePosted), about 4 months and one week ago, so the role may be filled. Still listed on quintor.nl/vacatures on 2026-11-03.

name: Sluyter Logistics

sizeBand.basis: Article says "met ruim 450 medewerkers"; sluyter-logistics.nl says "Ruim 450 medewerkers"

signal: Sluyter Logistics turns 100 in 2026 and was made Hofleverancier at an event at its Berkel en Rodenrijs site on 19 September.
sourceQuote: Sluyter Logistics viert dit jaar een bijzondere mijlpaal: de organisatie bestaat honderd jaar.
why: A centenary year with 450 staff over five sites is a natural reason for a December staff party, and a strip reading '100 jaar Sluyter' is a keepsake they would want.
notes: The relation event on 19 Sep already happened; the angle is the staff side of the jubilee year. Also reported by RTV Lansingerland and Nieuwsblad Transport (Google News, 21 and 22 Sep).

name: Rotterdam The Hague Airport
signal: Rotterdam The Hague Airport turned 70 on 1 October 2026 and published a jubilee page that thanks generations of staff.
sourceQuote: Vandaag, op 1 oktober 2026, bestaat Rotterdam The Hague Airport 70 jaar
why: A 70th jubilee year at a 24/7 site with many shift workers suits a booth that runs on its own for long events, at the same €299.
notes: Headcount not found on the pages opened (organisatie page, homepage); left null rather than guessed.

name: Saltwater Engineering
signal: Saltwater Engineering turns 20 this month (November 2026), a Dordrecht engineering firm that moved to the Leerpark in 2025.
sourceQuote: Saltwater Engineering bestaat deze maand twintig jaar.
why: A 20 year anniversary landing in November means a celebration is being planned right now, and a small team books the booth for one evening at a fixed €299.
notes: Founding year conflict: the article says 2006, a search snippet of a third-party profile says 2007 (not opened). A snippet said 20+ staff; not opened, so sizeBand is null. Smallest company in the list.

name: Hell’s Kitchen Horeca Groep
sector: Hospitality group (19 bars, restaurants, clubs, hotels)

sizeBand.basis: Article says "Bij de groep werken circa 700 medewerkers"

signal: Rotterdam hospitality group Hell’s Kitchen celebrates 25 years in 2026 and now runs 19 venues with about 700 staff.
sourceQuote: Hell’s Kitchen Horeca Groep viert dit jaar het 25-jarig bestaan.
why: Two routes in one, a 25 year staff party for 700 people and 19 venues that host group parties where a booth can be offered to guests.
notes: Also a partner route (venues such as Wester Paviljoen and Café Van Zanten host parties). Kept in leads because the jubilee is the dated signal.

name: Nieman Groep

sizeBand.basis: nieman.nl says "Met een groeiend team van meer dan 100 slimme en gedreven adviseurs" (Nieman Raadgevende Ingenieurs)

signal: Nieman Groep opened a new office on the 20th floor of the WTC in Den Haag, replacing its Rotterdam location, and was then acquired by Movares.
sourceQuote: Nieman Groep breidt haar aanwezigheid in Nederland uit met een nieuwe vestiging op de twintigste verdieping van het World Trade Center (WTC) in Den Haag.
why: A new office plus a new owner gives two reasons to bring people together before year end, and an opening borrel with a booth costs them €299.
notes: Gawalo (2026-09-30) reports Movares took over Nieman Groep three days after the office announcement.

name: Blömer
signal: Accountancy firm Blömer moves into the Galghenwert tower in Utrecht from January 2027 and says the move is about bringing colleagues and clients together.
sourceQuote: Accountants- en advieskantoor Blömer neemt vanaf januari 2027 zijn intrek in het kantoorgebouw Galghenwert aan het Herculesplein in Utrecht.
why: An office opening early in 2027 for staff, clients and relations is the kind of reception a branded booth fits, booked now for January.
notes: Headcount not found on blomer.nl homepage; null. Vastgoeddata (2026-10-15) reports 1,528 m² leased (seen in Google News title only, not opened).

name: Ore Energy
signal: Ore Energy raised €38 million in a Series A and is expanding its production, commercial and operational teams.
sourceQuote: Het Nederlandse Ore Energy heeft 38 miljoen euro opgehaald om zijn ijzer-luchtbatterijen op commerciële schaal te gaan produceren.
why: A freshly funded team that is hiring has a first big year-end to celebrate, and €299 is a rounding error on that budget.
notes: oreenergy.com lists addresses in both Delft (2629 JD) and Amsterdam (1051 DD). Delft used because its grid battery runs at TU Delft's Green Village. Headcount not found; null.

name: Robin Radar Systems
sector: Defence and aviation tech (drone and bird radar)

sizeBand.basis: LINK Magazine 2026-09-28: "verwacht het bedrijf eind 2026 meer dan 300 medewerkers te tellen"

signal: Robin Radar opens its new 9,000 m² Delft headquarters on 12 November 2026 with a visit from King Willem-Alexander, after three years of 60 percent growth.
sourceQuote: Op 12 november opent Robin haar Delftse hoofdkantoor aan de Energieweg.
why: A headcount near 300 in a building three times bigger, opened in November, makes a first Christmas party in the new HQ very likely.
notes: The royal opening itself is a protocol event, so pitch the staff party in the new building, not the 12 Nov opening.

name: W.I.S.V. 'Christiaan Huygens'
sector: Study association (TU Delft, maths and computer science)
signal: Study association Christiaan Huygens is in its 14th lustrum year, with lustrum weeks from 16 November 2026 and a lustrum programme running to an end party on 25 June 2027.
sourceQuote: On Monday we will kick off our very first lustrum week with a Silent Disco!
why: A lustrum year has a party committee (the LuCie) with a budget and a run of parties, so one booking can become several at €299 each.
notes: signalDate is the event date shown on the page. The 14th lustrum is stated on the opening party page (https://ch.tudelft.nl/activities/event/2026/lustrum-opening-party/, 10 Sep 2026 at STECK). Full lustrum calendar read from https://ch.tudelft.nl/feed/ical/ on 2026-11-03.

name: Studievereniging UNFC
sector: Study association (Maritime Technology, Rotterdam Mainport Institute)
signal: UNFC's annual Christmas gala for students and staff of the Rotterdam Mainport Institute is scheduled for 17 December 2026, organised with other Rotterdam study associations.
why: A themed, dress-code gala six weeks out with a dedicated committee is a classic photobooth booking, and Framed already lists student and school events.
notes: Event page published 2026-09-03 (datePublished); startDate 2026-12-17T20:00. Description from https://unfc.nl/activiteiten/kerstgala/: 'Elk jaar organiseert de UNFC Kerstgala Commissie een betoverend kerstgala voor de studenten en docenten van de RMI-opleidingen.' Site meta describes UNFC as the association for Maritieme Techniek at the Rotterdam Mainport Institute.

name: Vereniging Ambachtse Ondernemers (VAO)

sizeBand.basis: Page says "onze club van meer dan 200 enthousiaste ondernemers"

signal: The Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht business association lists its Kerstborrel for 8 December 2026.
why: A booth at a borrel full of 200 local business owners is a demo in front of future bookers, so it doubles as marketing near Dordrecht.
notes: Page gives only the date, no venue or time. signalDate is the event date.

name: Barrio (by the team behind Biergarten Rotterdam)
sector: Hospitality, new restaurant and music venue
signal: The owners of Biergarten open Barrio, a Latin American restaurant and live music venue in the Schieblock, on Saturday 14 November 2026.
sourceQuote: Op zaterdag 14 november opent Barrio in het Schieblock in Rotterdam Central District.
why: A new venue with a stage and a Friday programme needs reasons for groups to book it, and a booth for its opening night or December group bookings is a cheap draw.
notes: Also a partner route via Biergarten Rotterdam's group bookings. Small team; no headcount found.
